Buying or selling real estate should feel exciting—not overwhelming. Andra Cortez Jackson Jr. combines trusted guidance, responsive communication, and experienced advocacy to help every client move forward with clarity and confidence.

Andra proudly assists:

🏠 First-time and experienced homebuyers
🔑 Homeowners preparing to sell
🏗️ New-construction buyers
📦 Relocation clients and families
📈 New and seasoned real estate investors

Clients appreciate Andra’s:

✅ Strong negotiation and advocacy
✅ Prompt, dependable communication
✅ Extensive local-market knowledge
✅ Creative, solution-focused approach
✅ Ability to simplify complex transactions
✅ Commitment to protecting their interests

Whether he is helping a buyer find the right home, negotiating valuable builder incentives, positioning a property to achieve the strongest possible outcome, or helping an investor uncover an overlooked opportunity, Andra remains personally involved from the first conversation through closing—and beyond.

Most importantly, Andra believes successful real estate begins with relationships, not pressure. His role is to listen, educate, and provide honest guidance so every client feels informed, protected, and confident in each decision.

If you are considering buying, selling, investing, relocating, or exploring new construction in Austin or Central Texas, connect with Andra and discover how experienced, personalized representation can make all the difference.

questions_and_answers.question_text: What’s the top reason to hire you?
questions_and_answers.answer_text:
🏡 Why should you hire me as your REALTOR®?

Because I combine more than 15 years of real estate experience with personal, hands-on service—and I treat your goals as if they were my own.

As a lifelong Central Texas professional with previous experience working for a Fortune 500 home builder, I understand both resale and new-construction transactions from the inside out. I know how to evaluate opportunities, anticipate potential problems, negotiate favorable terms, and help clients avoid costly mistakes.

But experience alone is not enough. Every client has a different timeline, budget, concern, and definition of success. I take the time to listen, explain your options clearly, and create a strategy tailored specifically to you.

Clients choose to work with me because I am:

✅ Responsive, accessible, and easy to reach
✅ Experienced in resale, new construction, land, and investment properties
✅ Skilled at negotiating price, repairs, incentives, and contract terms
✅ Strategic in identifying opportunities others may overlook
✅ Calm and solutions-focused when challenges arise
✅ Personally involved from our first conversation through closing

Whether you are buying your first home, selling a property, relocating, building an investment portfolio, or navigating an important life transition, you deserve an experienced advocate who will protect your interests and keep the process moving forward.

Real estate is more than a transaction. It is one of the most important financial and personal decisions you may make.

🔑 When you are ready to make your next move, I am ready to help you move forward with confidence.

questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the latest market trend in your service area?
questions_and_answers.answer_text:
• Inventory is up — supply favors buyers

The number of active home listings has surged, giving buyers more choices.

Some reports put months-of-inventory (MOI) in a more “balanced” to “buyer-friendly” range, compared with the tight-supply, high-demand conditions seen during the pandemic housing boom. 

Because of this, many homes are lingering longer on the market and getting price reductions, rather than going under contract immediately. 

• Prices easing (or at least leveling off), improving affordability compared with recent years

According to one recent snapshot, the median sale price in Austin was around $537,000 (as of October 2025), a slight year-over-year dip. 
Redfin

The “list-price per square foot” and listing prices have also seen downward adjustments in parts of the metro — a contrast from the runaway inflation of home prices during the 2020–2022 BOOM.

New-construction homes are playing an increasing role in the market. In many cases, they’re listed at discounts relative to older/resale homes — which is a reversal from the usual premium attached to new builds in many markets. 

• Market cooling and more negotiation power for buyers (less frenzy, more realistic pricing)

Homes are spending more time on the market (longer “days on market”), meaning buyers have more breathing room. 

According to a recent listing-to-pending analysis, the ratio of new listings to contracts is unusually high — meaning many more homes are listed than being bought right now. 

In some segments (especially outside ultra-hot luxury neighborhoods), the market appears less competitive — offering buyers leverage on price, terms, and negotiation.
